column1: # STEP3_RUNS_release_N.tsv: the step 3 reruns of version 2 (REVERIFICATION.md). Each command runs from its folder in a writable
# copy of the archive, after the shipped outputs of the run are renamed aside (the programs open their outputs with mode x).
# The rows of one m3 chain run in order; the first also moves the family memo aside. The prep pieces of a chain are budgeted:
# a piece stops PARTIAL when its next unit would exceed its budget, and the next piece continues, until one prints
# "PREP16 <family> piece <k>: DONE"; a rerun may therefore need more or fewer pieces than the carried run (the rows marked
# "extra prep piece" have no carried form). The outputs these runs wrote are under records/step3/out at their package paths;
# cmp_certified.py --pkg records/step3/out --images . --tables records/step3 REPORT compares those with carried forms, and
# sha256sum -c records/step3/STEP3_TABLES_release_N.sha256 (from the archive root, after a rerun of the chains) checks the
# rebuilt table data files against the data record (the primary evidence for the chains); STEP3_HANDOFFS_release_N.tsv lists the
# rebuilt hand-off records, which differ from the data record only in the fields named there. CERT_PAIRS_release_N.tsv holds the
# outputs whose comparison passes: every output of the other step 3 runs and, of the chains, the outputs of the smoke items and the
# hand-off .json files of the entry and resume items; the chain consoles and prep pieces are not in it, because the budgeted pieces
# split the work differently, the consoles print table hand-off checksums that follow the kernel checksum, and the UNIT16 lines
# carry CPU times. Rows whose note names the access hook: their .err holds a message of code/acc/acc2_v1.py, because the run
# harness gave several items one ACC2_LOG path and the hook opens it with mode x; it is not output of m3_run_v1_9_3.py, and where
# the item has a carried form, its carried .err is empty. Columns: run, program, folder, command, outputs, carried form, note.
